name: @filter-enginez/ui-styles
description: Filter EngineZ — framework-agnostic component CSS (semantic/BEM classes built on @filter-enginez/brand tokens). Consumed by the react-ui presentational components and directly by every demo app; its algorithm figures (./figures.css) only where they are drawn: the documentation (docs site and both React apps' /docs) and the landing site's how-it-works page. Ships plain CSS; no build, no runtime deps.
